hypotheses.rationale: Establishing exact variant-level numerators and denominators allows diagnostic clinicians to distinguish classic severe MMDS1 from milder hypomorphic SPG93 presentations across pediatric ataxia and HSP screening panels.

hypotheses.text: Pure hereditary spastic paraplegia without accompanying cerebellar ataxia, dysarthria, or polyneuropathy occurs in fewer than 25% of individuals in the defining SPG93 cohort, with the vast majority presenting with a complex neurodegenerative syndrome over long-term follow-up.
hypotheses.rationale: Clarifying the exact numerator of pure vs complex HSP cases in the defining literature resolves whether clinicians should suspect NFU1 in isolated spastic paraplegia or primarily when complicated by cerebellar/neuropathic features.

new_directions.question_text: Does the biochemical biomarker profile (blood lactate, pyruvate, urinary organic acids) show intermittent or persistent elevation in SPG93 cohorts compared to MMDS1?
